children: WaFd announced an all-stock merger with EverBank that will leave former EverBank holders with approximately 59.175% of the combined company and WaFd holders with about 40.825% on a fully diluted basis. WaFd estimates issuing roughly 107.7 million fully diluted shares at closing. The transaction includes a rollover of EverBank’s preferred stock into a new WaFd series with substantially equivalent terms and sets a 13-member board split between seven Legacy EverBank and six Legacy WaFd directors. In a related pact, WaFd entered a Shareholders Agreement with key EverBank investors providing director nomination rights, voting commitments, staged lock-ups over 12 months, and registration rights. The merger requires WaFd shareholder and regulatory approvals; a $101.1 million termination fee may be payable by WaFd under certain conditions.
